verdict.rationale: Zep is a context and memory layer. Its own data-ingestion pipeline could plausibly consume MCP servers as tool or data sources, so this MCP-client axis applies. The evidence only documents Zep acting as an MCP server (the Memory MCP Server and the experimental Graphiti MCP server) that external clients connect to. That server-side role is not credited here, and nothing shows Zep connecting to third-party MCP servers or using their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
